text:
Type: dark wood three-drawer chest
Use: storing clothes and linens, top for lamps and decor; bedroom, hallway, living room
Style: traditional, farmhouse, Scandinavian
Materials: solid pine with a black-brown stain that shows the grain, round wooden knobs
Colors: dark black-brown, deep espresso
Shape: wide low chest with three deep drawers, two small round knobs on each, inset fronts within a framed carcass, overhanging top, short square legs, solid medium visual weight
Feel: warm, sturdy, classic, homey
Goes with: white walls, light linen, warm wood floors, black accents; traditional or farmhouse bedrooms

product.name: HEMNES
product.description: Of course your home should be a safe place for the entire family. Thats why a safety fitting is included so that you can attach the chest of drawers to the wall.
